data.text: Contrario launches after crossing $6M annualized revenue Solutions Features Customers Domains Resources Sign in Get a demo Back to blogs Better recruiting. Built on Contrario. Category Announcement Posted on May 20, 2026 In under six months, Contrario has crossed $6M in annualized revenue and paid out over $1M to an expert network of hundreds of recruiters. Today, 200+ of the fastest-growing companies, including unicorns like Slash and Wispr Flow, run their hiring on Contrario. We have never had more conviction in the opportunity ahead for Contrario, our recruiters, and our partners. Since day one, our goal has been the same: free recruiters and companies from the repetitive parts of hiring so they can focus on the uniquely human ones. As AI capabilities have expanded, so has our ambition for what recruiting can become. The recruiting inflection point For the last 15 years, recruiting tech got better, but never truly differentiated. From 2010 to 2025, most of the category built SaaS tools for recruiting teams: ATS products, outbound sourcing, and screening software. While each one made existing tasks faster, none fundamentally changed what recruiting looks like. That era is ending. What’s different now isn’t speed – it’s the ability to rely on memory and judgment. The next generation of software can match context, like why they are more likely to accept a certain profile. Or how a company should hire for a new role based on their previous decisions. Agents learn across many company workflows, including: Holding a company's hiring bar deeply enough to recognize shape of a fit Understanding how a candidate grows as a person over time Recognizing when a candidate from a past search is right for a new role The way recruiters work is also changing with agents. Repetitive admin work like sourcing, scheduling, and follow-ups still consumes more than 50% of a recruiter’s time. Agents automate that work away. And now, recruiters can spend time on what matters most: building relationships with people. We're already seeing the early signal of what this looks like. Roughly 30% of hires made on Contrario in the last two months had agents involved, and top recruiters are earning 3x more on our workflows. This is the beginning of a much larger shift in how hiring gets done, and Contrario is the platform behind it. The agent-native recruiter Recruiters in the agentic era look closer to a sports agent: managing high-value relationships and maximizing their candidate’s chances of success. Agents work on their behalf continuously in the background between meetings, during lunch breaks, and while they sleep. For companies, an intelligence layer forms underneath hiring. With every hiring decision, the system learns a company’s standards, patterns behind successful hires, and how quickly they need to move. By the 20th hire, the system understands an organization in ways only a long-tenured employee ever could. We are building toward a world where the pipeline never resets. Where candidates stay in motion across chapters of their career, with context intact. Where companies don’t reset with every new role, because a system already understands them. Where a recruiter walks into every conversation already prepared the way a great agent prepares for the most important meeting of their client's career. So, the next chapter of Contrario is about depth: richer context on every candidate, deeper understanding of every partner we serve, and agents that empower the best recruiters in the world. To every recruiter on our platform, every company that's trusted us with a critical hire, and every employee helping us build Contrario, thank you. Our goal remains simple: help everyone hire great talent faster. Recruiting is being rebuilt and we’re just getting started. Their hiring challenge was not finding candidates. It was finding the right ones, fast, without adding noise to their existing recruiting operations. Arya Marwaha Co-Founder & CEO May 19, 2026 $100M raised as of Jan 2026 20+ hired in 2 months $500M Valuation at Series B, Jan 2026 Listen Labs is an autonomous market research platform trusted by enterprise organizations including Microsoft, Google, Nestlé, and P&G. The company announced $100M in funding and reached a valuation of over $500M in January 2026. Anish Rao joined as Head of Growth at the time of their Series B announcement, stepping into a function that needed to scale quickly. Alfred Wahlforss Co-Founder & CEO Florian Juengermann Co-Founder & CTO Anish Rao Head of Growth THE PROBLEM Too much volume, not enough signal By Series B, Listen Labs had the hiring infrastructure most growing companies aspire to have: an internal talent team, recruiting tools, and established processes. The problem was not a lack of tools or applications. It was that the inbound volume was becoming unmanageable. The talent team was spending a disproportionate amount of time reviewing submissions, conducting early-stage screening calls, and managing the overhead of a high-volume pipeline – only to advance a small fraction of candidates. Time that should have been directed toward closing critical roles was spent on filtering through noise that the team did not have the bandwidth to manage. The longer those roles sat open, the more directly it affected Listen Labs’ ability to execute on its growth plans. THE SOLUTION Recruiting that runs itself Listen Labs did not need to change how they hired. Contrario connected to Listen Labs' ATS, ensuring that candidate records, pipeline stages, and hiring decisions were synchronized without requiring manual input from the talent team. Outreach was handled on their behalf, interviews were scheduled automatically, and the right stakeholders were looped in at the right stage. There was no new platform to onboard or disruption to the processes the team had already built. What mattered as much as the infrastructure was the speed of calibration. Contrario's recruiters on the partnership had deep expertise in go-to-market hiring. They understood from the outset what a strong candidate looks like at a Series B company with enterprise customers and aggressive growth targets. That calibration continued to sharpen over time. Every hiring decision Listen Labs made was fed back into Contrario's system, allowing agents on the platform to recalibrate continuously. The more decisions were made, the more precisely the candidate recommendations reflected Listen Labs' talent bar. "Hiring for demand generation and marketing operations became significantly easier once we started working with Contrario." — Anish Rao, Head of Growth, Listen Labs THE IMPACT Leaner process with better results The roles that had been difficult to fill were closed in under a month. By working directly within Listen Labs' existing workflows, the team spent 40% less time evaluating inbound candidates. Time that had previously been absorbed by screening and coordination was redirected toward higher-value work across the rest of the organization. When Listen Labs began working with Contrario, the company was approximately 40 people and has since grown to 60. The hires Contrario placed have been central to that growth. Listen Labs did not need more recruiting vendors or candidate sources – they needed fewer, better ones. Contrario will continue to partner with Listen Labs across its go-to-market function as the company scales toward its next stage of growth. data.text: Contrario launches after crossing $6M annualized revenue Solutions Features Customers Domains Resources Sign in Get a demo Back to blogs CASE STUDY How Gallium made 4 engineering hires in 15 days with Contrario With a small team and an ambitious roadmap, Gallium needed not only great engineers, but ones willing to take an early bet on them. Arya Marwaha Co-Founder & CEO May 16, 2026 4 hires made 15 days from opening to hire 100% of their eng team hired through Contrario Gallium is building the first AI-native operating system for marketing. The platform combines specialized AI models with human content engineers to help companies own their category narrative across LinkedIn, X, SEO, and AI Search. Gallium believes that the companies that win will be the ones who own the narrative of their category consistently and at scale. Delivering on that vision required an engineering team with the technical depth to build AI systems in production and the ability to move at the pace an early-stage startup demanded. Jaisal Kothari Co-Founder Akshat Sharma Co-Founder Vinicius Brown Founding Software Engineer Jose Thomaz Founding Data Engineer Carlos Libardo Founding Data Engineer Marcos Gritti Founding ML Engineer THE PROBLEM The early-stage hiring problem Early-stage companies do not have the luxury of a talent team, a structured recruiting process, or a track record that sells itself to candidates. What they have is a founder, a vision, and a finite amount of time to act on both. For Jaisal, Co-Founder of Gallium, the challenge of hiring was pulling him away from the valuable work that only a founder can do. Every hour spent writing job descriptions, reviewing applications, scheduling calls, and managing candidate pipelines was an hour not spent on the product, customers, or the company strategy. At an early-stage startup, a wrong hire would not just slow the company down. It could ripple into long-term product and culture setbacks that take years to recover from. Beyond the sourcing challenge, there was a harder problem: convincing exceptional engineers to take an early bet on Gallium. Doing so requires preparation, conviction, and expertise in how to position the opportunity compellingly. THE SOLUTION A strategic recruiting partner Contrario brought more than sourcing capability. Most seed-stage founders know what they need in a general sense, but translating that into a precise hiring strategy can be difficult to articulate. Contrario worked closely with the Gallium team to define what the engineering function actually needed: what roles should be called, what their scope should cover, what skills to look for, and what the hiring roadmap should look like in the future. From there, Contrario built a sourcing profile around the qualities that would determine success for Gallium. Recruiters on Contrario drew from their network of engineers across LATAM. Each recruiter understood how to pitch Gallium and worked with candidates who were already interested and aligned before they ever spoke with the founders. This allowed interviews to be a genuine assessment of fit rather than a cold pitch. "Our favorite thing about Contrario for hiring is the speed with which you work. You can send great candidates faster than anyone else we have worked with. This was one of the biggest reasons we ended up hiring all of them through Contrario." — Jaisal Kothari, Co-Founder, Gallium THE IMPACT Setting the standard Gallium's entire engineering team was hired through Contrario in fifteen days. The speed was significant. What proved equally valuable over time was the character and caliber of the hires themselves. The engineers Contrario placed brought exactly the ownership instinct that Jaisal and Akshat had been looking for. Carlos Eduardo Libardo, Founding AI Engineer, had already built two companies before joining Gallium. Marcos Gritti, Founding ML Engineer, was a former professor with 10 years of research experience. Vinicius Brown, Founding Software Engineer, shipped a two-month roadmap in his first twelve days. Jose Thomaz, Founding Data Engineer, rewrote a data pipeline that nobody wanted to touch, over a single weekend, with zero downtime. With the caliber of the team, Jaisal has been able to step back substantially. The engineers make decisions independently, sustain momentum on their own, and are not constrained by his bandwidth. "The biggest standout for the candidates has been ownership. Over time I have had to be increasingly less involved because the team is capable of making their own decisions and continuing to move forward. They are not limited by my own pace or my biases." — Jaisal Kothari, Co-Founder, Gallium For a founder whose time is the company's most constrained resource, you need a team that accelerates the work that you are doing. The first engineers a company hires set the pace, the culture, and the ceiling for what the team can become. Contrario will continue to partner with Gallium as it scales, placing the people who allow the founders to stay focused on what only they can do.
